templates.why_chosen: The bottom half draws two Node boxes as identical Ingress-gateway/Pod, Virtual-switch, NIC stacks, linked by orange inter-node and yellow intra-node paths labelled Path 1 and Path 2, the double-column full-stack variant.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack each mirrored side as gateway/pod over virtual switch over NIC, and colour the two kinds of crossing path differently, orange for inter-node, yellow for intra-node, so a reader sees at a glance which path a request re-traverses the network stack; keep the busy per-pod annotations and legend from crowding the main stack shape.
